gaps.sentence: The venue was changed at ___ notice, just two days before.
gaps.explanation: 'At short notice' = only a short time before.
'from 1 January' = beginning on that date (also 'with effect from').

gaps.sentence: The proposal was rejected ___ a single vote.
gaps.explanation: 'by a single vote / by two goals' — the margin takes 'by'.

gaps.sentence: ___ first glance, the deal looks generous.
gaps.explanation: 'At first glance' = when first looked at quickly.

gaps.sentence: ___ the whole, the feedback was positive.
The neighbours complained ___ the noise until dawn.
gaps.explanation: complain ABOUT something; 'in the small hours' = after midnight. Only the first gap is checked.

gaps.sentence: I'm in no ___ — take your time deciding.
The bridge is at ___ open to traffic after three years of works.
